name: vector-editor-rig
title: Vector Editor Rig
description: Vector editor for vertical reels: a dark brand editor restacked for a portrait field – title bar, a tool row, a canvas where a brand-red bezier path draws on with anchors, handles and a selection frame, then layers and properties side by side. The active tool and path name are fields. Montserrat 28 px, sized for the 780 px graphics field.
